PRIMARY_FOCUS_GUIDANCE.food_quality: make the food itself the main reason for the review
PRIMARY_FOCUS_GUIDANCE.service: make the staff interaction or service flow the main point
PRIMARY_FOCUS_GUIDANCE.ambience: make the room, comfort, or mood the main point
PRIMARY_FOCUS_GUIDANCE.value: make the price-to-experience tradeoff the main point
PRIMARY_FOCUS_GUIDANCE.speed: make wait time or turnaround the main point
PRIMARY_FOCUS_GUIDANCE.cleanliness: make cleanliness or upkeep the main point

SENTIMENT_GUIDANCE.positive: sound clearly favorable with a grounded detail

VISIT_MODE_GUIDANCE.dine_in: sound like the person was physically in the restaurant
VISIT_MODE_GUIDANCE.takeout: sound like the review is about a takeout order
VISIT_MODE_GUIDANCE.delivery: sound like the review is about delivery arrival and condition
VISIT_MODE_GUIDANCE.drive_through: sound like the review is about a drive-through experience

OPENING_STYLE_GUIDANCE.verdict_first: open with a quick verdict or first impression
OPENING_STYLE_GUIDANCE.detail_first: open with the concrete thing that stood out
OPENING_STYLE_GUIDANCE.context_first: open with a little visit context before the judgment

LENGTH_STYLE_GUIDANCE.detailed: include a bit more context and consequence

DETAIL_STYLE_GUIDANCE.single_observation: center the review on one strong observation
DETAIL_STYLE_GUIDANCE.specific_example: include one concrete example or symptom
DETAIL_STYLE_GUIDANCE.balanced_note: briefly note both the good and bad parts

CLOSING_STYLE_GUIDANCE.none: the review can end without a recommendation line
CLOSING_STYLE_GUIDANCE.recommend: end with a light recommendation or return intent
CLOSING_STYLE_GUIDANCE.conditional: end with a condition or caveat
CLOSING_STYLE_GUIDANCE.skip_returning: end with a clear sign that the reviewer would not come back

REPETITION_AVOIDANCE_GUIDANCE: Avoid repeating the same opening verdict across rows.
Do not reuse the same first four-word sequence.
Vary sentence rhythm between punchy and slightly descriptive.
When two rows share similar ratings, still vary the concrete detail.
